versions.content: Support for Logical Execution Time Type: valid Description: The AUTOSAR templates shall provide the means to support the description of Logical Execution Time (LET) respectively Time Determinism. In particular the following shall be described: • Parameters of a LET interval : Length, type of recurrence and recurrence • The relation between LET intervals, like offset, gap and overlap. • Executable entities and/or groups of executable entities that shall be executed in the context of LET. • Data exchange that shall be conducted in the context of a LET interval, namely the time deterministic exchange of data between executable entities and/or groups of executable entities. • Means to specify an order of execution among a number of executable entities. 5 22 of 34  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 410: AUTOSAR_RS_TimingExtensions Requirements on Timing Extensions AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Rationale: Time determinism is a crucial characteristic in embedded distributed real-time systems that ensures: • reliable operation of such systems due to deterministic data exchange and execution of executable entities, and • analysis and validation of such systems in order to perform timing analysis early in the development process. Use Case: Design and define timing behavior of applications as well as analysis and validation of timing behavior. Dependencies: [RS_TIMEX_00001], [RS_TIMEX_00002], [RS_TIMEX_00003], [RS_TIMEX_00004], [RS_TIMEX_00006] Supporting Material: None
